title: The consistency threshold is renamed in the pre-registered config
task_prompt: `consistency_min` has been renamed to `consistency_band_min` in the thresholds file. Make everything that reads it agree, and keep the suites green.
intent: a renamed configuration key; readers silently receive undefined instead of throwing, which is the failure mode under test

mutations.note: the rename; any reader of the old key now compares against undefined

oracle.expected_initial: a reader of consistency_min no longer finds it, and at least one check fails or silently stops enforcing
oracle.expected_final: 52/52 with the reader and the config reconciled

gold.known_trap: the silent failure mode is an undefined comparison that passes rather than throws; a green suite does not prove the threshold is enforced
